title: Degree sums count the arcs of a digraph
statement:
Let $D$ be a digraph on a finite vertex set $V$, and write $\varepsilon$ for its number of arcs. Then both the sum of the indegrees and the sum of the outdegrees over all vertices equal $\varepsilon$:
\[
\sum_{v \in V} d^{-}(v) \;=\; \varepsilon \;=\; \sum_{v \in V} d^{+}(v).
\]
hypotheses_covered: D is a digraph on a finite vertex set V
